answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 6633 Country: India Title: Can a husband see the face of his dead wife, touch her, give her gusl etc. Please give detail proof according to sharia law (Quraan & Hadith). Question: Can a husband see the face of his dead wife, touch her, give her gusl etc. Please give detail proof according to sharia law (Quraan & Hadith). Answer ID: 6633 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 648/648=M/1429) A husband can see the face of his deceased wife; but he cannot touch her nor give her bath: کما فی الدر المختار: و یمنع زوجھا من غسلھا و مسھا لا من النظر الیھا علی الاصح Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
